reviewMethod: Direct visual inspection of native screenshots after each checkpoint
credentialPersistence: No password persisted by host controller; app uses its existing secure session store, then explicit logout clears the test session
registration: UI confirms account created and opens login with the synthetic email retained
hostReconciliation: Same new account login 200, me 200, CUSTOMER; identifier recorded in canonical-registration.json
nativeLogin: Profile shows expected synthetic display name/email, CUSTOMER and ACTIVE
coldProcessRestart: After am force-stop and Activity start, profile shows same synthetic identity
logout: Guest UI shown; notice confirms server revoked refresh token
limitations: Visual verification supplements existing transport-hook evidence; it does not increase the distinct UI API operation count or prove preservation of pre-task app data
